about: What listed accounts posted that the timeline does not carry: offered to incident.conductor@, who decides. Each is evidence (a report or a relay), with the post's address and the time it gives. We do not edit the timeline.

offers.what: AEMET (Spain's meteorological agency) says the storm is named Charles: 2 h 57 min before 13:17, the time row s-1109T1317 gives for IPMA's communiqué. Either IPMA's naming was public before 13:17, or 13:17 is an edit time: worth checking at IPMA.

The 09:00 red rain for Lisbon was relayed in public at 22:20 by VOST Portugal (57 min after IPMA sent it). Row s-1111T0015 says no press title had it by 00:15: still true of the press; a volunteers' association had it.
Lusa: traffic without restrictions on the Vasco da Gama and 25 de Abril bridges (row s-1110T1425 has them limited to 60 km/h).
Rede Expressos suspends all services nationwide on Wednesday 10:00 to 23:59 and refunds tickets (VOST relaying the operator).

offers.what: The UK's Met Office posts on Storm Charles (Madeira, Portugal, Spain): a foreign weather service speaking of it in public while IPMA has no account here.

offers.what: Lusa, citing civil protection: mainland Portugal had 66 occurrences at 03:30 on Wednesday.
Lusa: Madeira recorded 99 occurrences; electricity already restored.
Lusa: the insurance regulator recommends checking cover and keeping proof in case of damage (evidence: reported by Lusa; the regulator itself not read by us).
Lusa: 16 flights cancelled in Madeira because of the weather (evidence: reported by Lusa; the airport operator not read by us).

VOST: almost 800 occurrences recorded in Portugal on 10 November (00:00 to 23:59), mostly floods and fallen trees; Lisboa and Setúbal the most affected districts (evidence: VOST, a volunteer body; it names no source for the count).
Lusa: civil protection recorded 60 occurrences up to 06:00 (evidence: reported by Lusa; the headline does not say which area or from when).
Lusa: accesses to the centre of Funchal closed for safety reasons (evidence: reported by Lusa; read by eye, the word match did not keep this post).

Lusa: traffic on the Vasco da Gama bridge limited to 100 km/h because of the weather (evidence: reported by Lusa; the operator not read by us). The last row on the bridges, s-1110T2229, had them without restrictions.

Lusa: civil protection recorded 139 occurrences in Madeira up to 08:30. VOST, 09:05, gives about 200 between 20:00 on 10 Nov and 08:00 on 11 Nov, Santa Cruz, Funchal and Machico the most (bsky-vost.pt-3mzzlzkxb222l). The two counts differ; neither source is the regional service itself.
Lusa: accesses to Funchal reopened after being closed for safety (it closes the 07:50 offer; read by eye, the word match did not keep this post).
Lusa: more than 220 flights cancelled at Lisbon and Faro airports because of the weather (evidence: reported by Lusa; the airport operator not read by us).

Público on Web Summit: online meetings and smaller gatherings replace the conference, whose second day was cancelled; "Portas reabrem quinta-feira" (evidence: a press report, not the organisers; the organisers have posted nothing on Bluesky since 10 Nov 17:36 UTC).
Lusa, citing ANA (the airport operator): 360 flights cancelled at Portuguese airports because of the weather (was "more than 220" at Lisbon and Faro at 09:55).

VOST: 538 occurrences recorded in Portugal up to 12:00, mainly fallen trees and floods; it also says gusts may reach 100 km/h and the rain should intensify between 15:00 and 18:00 and may last until 21:00 (evidence: VOST, a volunteer body, names no source; the forecast part is theirs, not ours). Lusa, 12:54: "Depressão Charles perde força em Lisboa e ganha no Alentejo e Algarve" (bsky-lusa.pt-3mzzyshroch22).
Lusa: Madeira's regional civil protection counted 285 occurrences up to about 13:00 (evidence: the press relaying the authority).

Lusa: the Interior Ministry (MAI) says the alert situation ends today and expects normality to resume on Thursday (evidence: the press relaying the ministry; the decision itself is the government's to publish). Article: https://www.lusa.pt/article/48109287

VOST: rail traffic suspended on the Linha do Norte (fast up line, Bobadela Sul to Alverca), the Linha de Cintura (Alcântara tunnel), the Douro line (Régua to Pocinho) and the Beira Baixa line (from Santa Margarida). Evidence: VOST, volunteers, names no source; the operator's own notice decides.

VOST: 8 roads restricted; in Lisbon district the Eixo Norte-Sul (Avenida de Ceuta access), EN6 (Oeiras) and EN1 (Vila Franca de Xira); also Setúbal (EN10-1, EN378), Guarda (EN338, EN338-1), Portalegre (EN246-1). Evidence: VOST, volunteers, names no source. Supports s-1111T1539 on the Eixo Norte-Sul.

Lusa: a housing collective, Acampada de Lisboa, calls a gathering in front of Web Summit on Thursday. Bears on Day 3, not on the storm. Evidence: the press. Article: https://www.lusa.pt/article/48109917

VOST: 1602 occurrences in Portugal between 15:00 and 17:00; Lisboa, Setúbal and Faro the districts with most; mainly floods, road clearing and fallen trees. Evidence: VOST, volunteers, names no source.

Lusa: the national civil protection counted 1,630 occurrences since 00:00 (evidence: the press relaying the authority). Hypothesis (ours): VOST's "1,602 between 15:00 and 17:00" (s-1111T1853) is so close to this day total that its window may be a misreading of a since-midnight count; worth a check.
Lusa: close to 400 flights cancelled at Lisbon, Porto, Faro and Madeira (evidence: the press).
Lusa: IPMA says the prevention measures were the right ones for the forecasts (evidence: the press relaying IPMA).

Lusa: Madeira's regional civil protection counted 325 occurrences up to 18:40; VOST (19:27, bsky-vost.pt-3n22osb3bcc2o) gives 328 to the same time (evidence: the press and volunteers relaying the authority).

Web Summit's organisers, on their own Bluesky account (first post since 10 Nov 17:36 UTC): "Welcome to the last day of #WebSummit 2026! Yesterday may have been cancelled, but we are making up for it in a huge way. Today is officially Web Summit's biggest-ever day of content and meetups!" The organisers' own word that Day 3 runs and Wednesday was cancelled. Told to the conductor at 09:16 UTC.
offers.later: Deleted by the organisers: at 09:46 UTC the address answers "Post not found". The same text was posted again at 09:23:34 UTC (https://bsky.app/profile/websummit.bsky.social/post/3n245iu57wk2i), without the duplicated closing line of the first; told to the conductor at 09:47 UTC.

offers.what: VOST: 123 occurrences in Portugal from 19:00 on 11 Nov to 10:00 on 12 Nov; Lisboa, Santarém and Faro the districts with most. Evidence: VOST, volunteers, names no source.
